उदीचीन a.
1 Turned towards the
north.
--2 Northern.

उदीच्य a. Situated or living in
the north.
--च्यः
1 The country
to the north and west of the river
Sarasvatī; northern country.
--2
(pl.) The inhabitants of the north;

.
--च्यं A kind of perfume.
--Comp.
--वृत्तं a kind of Vaitālīya
metre.

; to be

seen, appear.
--2 To be produced,
come out or arise from, spring or
proceed from; उदितदयः

ever-existing.
--2 High, tall, lofty.
--3 Grown,
augmented.
--4 Born, produced.
--5 Spoken, uttered (fr. वद्).
--तं
1 A kind of perfume.
--2 A kind of
accent.
--Comp.
--उदित a. well
grounded in the Śāstras.
--होमिन्
a. sacrificing after sunrise.

उदितिः f.
1 Ascending, rising (of
the sun).
--2 Setting.
--3 Speech.

.
--2 To expect, look out for, wait for,
शत्रुव्यसनं

1 Looking up to.
--2
Seeing, beholding, seeking.

उदीप a. [उद्गता आपो यत्र, अप ईप्]
Flooded.
--पः High water,
inundation, flood.

उदीर् {c2c} A. [उद्-ईर्]
1 To rise
(sound &c.); उदैरत रणितानि

were heard.
--2 To start (to go or
come).
--3 To move upwards,
ascend, go up.
--4 To arise, originate.
--

.
--3 To
call, name; स भीमरूपः शिव इत्युदीर्यते

.
--5 To cast,
throw, roll down (as dice);
उदीरयामास सलीलमक्षान्

; to
discharge, drive forward.
--6 To raise,
throw up; उदीरितं रजः Śi. 12. 58;
उदैरयच्छिरः

expanded its
hood.
--7 To display, manifest, make
visible, cause;
तिसृभिस्त्वमवस्थाभिर्महिमानमुदीरयन्

; ˚धी
acuteminded. --pass.
1 To be cast or
thrown upwards, excited, uttered
&c.
--2 To sound.
--3 To issue forth.

1 Utterance,
pronunciation, expression; उद्घातः प्रणवो यासां
न्यायैस्त्रिभिरुदीरणं

.
--2
Speaking, saying.
--3 Throwing,
discharging (as a missile.).

उदीर्ण p. p. [ईर्-क्त]
1 Grown,
ascended, risen, produced, caused;
Śi. 18. 37.
--2 Puffed up, elated,
grown haughty;
भवल्लब्धवरोदीर्णस्तारकाख्यो महासुरः

.
--4 Increased,
intense.
--5 Generous, great;
excellent.
--6 Uttered, pronounced;
Śi. 13. 42.
--7 Ready, strung; ˚धन्वा

.
--र्णः N. of Viṣṇu.
--Comp.
--दीधिति a. intensely bright.
--वेग a. violent, impetuous in
its course (as a torrent).

To point out,
signify, declare, denote, mention,
tell; प्रथमोद्दिष्टमास्पदं

;
यथोद्दिष्टव्यापारा Ś. 3; अनेडमूक उद्दिष्टः शठे Med.
denotes or signifies.
--2 To
enunciate, prophesy; त्वं साधुभिरुद्दिष्टः
Ś. 5.
--3 To refer or allude to, have
reference to; स्मरमुद्दिश्य

.
--5
To explain, teach, advise; सतां
केनोद्दिष्टं विषममसिधाराव्रतमिदं

उद्दिश्य ind.
1 With reference to,
aiming at, in the direction of,
towards; वध्यशिलामुद्दिश्य प्रस्थितः

.
--2 For, for the sake of, on
account of, in the name of; त्वां˚
Ś. 3 on thy account; किं˚ for what
purpose, on what account; निमित्तं˚

. in your name.
--3 Demanding, stipulating for.

उद्दिष्ट p. p.
1 Mentioned,
particularized, specially told.
--2 Desired,
wished for.
--3 Explained, taught &c.

उद्दीप् {c4c} A. To flame, blaze up,
be kindled; वाणवदनमुददीपि भिये
Śi. 15. 48; उद्दीप्यस्व जातवेदः Kauś.
--

To light up, inflame,
illuminate, kindle; उद्दीपितकोपानलाः

1 Inflaming, lighting.
--2
An inflamer.
--3 That which
animates or excites.
--पं Bdellium.

उद्दीपक a.
1 Exciting, rendering
more intense; गरलस्योद्दीपकतया

1 Inflaming, exciting;
क्रोध˚, अग्नि˚.
--2 (In Rhet.) That which
excites or feeds (a sentiment or
rasa), any aggravating or attendant
circumstance which gives
poignancy to a feeling or passion;
उद्दीपनविभावास्ते रसमुद्दीपयंति ये S.

उद्दीप्त p. p.
1 Lighted, set on fire.
--2 Shining, bright.
--3 Inflamed,
excited, aggravated (as passion).
